watches.name: Naga Granturismo Chronograph 39 Veloce 1976
watches.description: In 1976 , Italian Grand Touring culture was living through one of its most fascinating eras. Sports coupés combined performance, elegance and driving pleasure, shaping an unmistakably Italian interpretation of sportiness. Fifty years later, the NAGA Granturismo Chronograph Veloce 1976 reinterprets that same spirit through a contemporary language. The vivid red dial is defined by cream/ivory subdials and tachymeter scale , a colour combination that recalls the analogue instruments, interiors and bodywork of the great Italian Grand Tourers of the period. A warm and instantly recognisable contrast that gives the chronograph a distinctly sporting identity without sacrificing refinement. Housed in a perfectly balanced 39 mm case , Veloce 1976 offers a confident yet natural presence on the wrist. Inside, the Seiko VK64 Meca-Quartz movement combines quartz precision with the response and mechanical feel of a traditional chronograph. Fifty years on, Veloce 1976 captures that spirit and translates it into a contemporary expression: red, ivory and steel come together in a chronograph that celebrates a distinctly Italian way of understanding speed, where style and performance travel together .

watches.name: Naga Granturismo Chronograph 39 Amalfi
watches.description: Inspired by the roads suspended between rock and the Mediterranean along the Amalfi Coast , the NAGA Granturismo Chronograph Amalfi interprets the sports chronograph through a brighter, more elegant and unmistakably Italian perspective. The light dial is defined by dark counters and blue accents , a contrast inspired by sunlit stone, deep coastal shadows and the changing tones of the sea. The result is a distinctive, fresh and instantly recognizable design that balances sporty character with refinement. Housed in a perfectly proportioned 39 mm case , Amalfi offers a confident yet natural presence on the wrist. Inside, the Seiko VK64 Meca-Quartz movement combines quartz accuracy with the tactile response and mechanical feel of a traditional chronograph. Time remains easy to read in every condition, while the dial’s contrasting elements preserve an elegant and dynamic identity, perfectly in tune with the Granturismo spirit. 100M water resistance and screw-down crown. Designed to accompany the journey, not simply measure it, Amalfi moves effortlessly from the road to the city, from day into evening. For those moments when time seems to stand still, while you keep moving.

watches.name: Naga Opera 39 Red Tiger Eye
watches.description: The dress evolution of our NAGA 39 Automatic. Unique natural stone dials, refined finishes, and one-of-a-kind patterns — as unique as time itself. Red Tiger Eye gives the Opera collection a warm, intense and magnetic presence. Each dial is crafted from a thin slice of natural stone, carefully selected for the depth of its veining and its distinctive shifting reflections. Rich shades of reddish brown, copper and amber change with the light, creating a vivid and almost hypnotic effect on the wrist. No two dials are ever identical: every watch preserves a unique mineral pattern, shaped by nature over time. Elegant yet bold, Opera Red Tiger Eye combines the refinement of a dress watch with the raw character of natural stone. A dial that evokes energy, protection and transformation — symbols deeply connected to the NAGA universe.

watches.name: Naga Granturismo Chronograph 39 DAKAR
watches.description: Inspired by the relentless spirit of the world’s toughest desert rally, the NAGA Granturismo Chronograph Dakar Edition captures the raw beauty and endurance of off-road racing. Its distinctive light sand-colored dial echoes the vast desert landscapes, evoking sun-bleached dunes, extreme conditions, and the courage required to cross them. Housed in a balanced 39 mm case, this chronograph blends rugged character with refined elegance. At its core, the Seiko VK64 Meca-Quartz movement delivers quartz precision combined with the satisfying mechanical feel of a traditional chronograph — ideal for those who demand reliability in every environment. The highly legible sub-dials recall professional racing instruments, while the warm desert tone of the dial gives the watch a unique presence that stands apart from conventional sport chronographs. 100m Water resistant and screwed crown. Built for adventure yet refined for everyday wear, the Dakar Edition transitions effortlessly from outdoor exploration to urban life. A timepiece forged in the spirit of endurance — for those who push beyond the horizon.

Encased in a perfectly balanced 39 mm case, this chronograph combines technical character with refined elegance. At its heart, the Seiko VK64 Meca-Quartz movement delivers quartz-level accuracy paired with the mechanical feel of a traditional chronograph — ideal for those who demand reliability under pressure. The striking black-and-white contrast ensures instant readability in any condition, echoing the dashboard gauges of endurance race cars designed to perform day and night without compromise. 100m Water resistant and screwed crown. Engineered for performance yet versatile enough for everyday wear, the Le Mans Edition transitions effortlessly from the track to the city. Designed for those who demand more from every second.

watches.name: Naga Granturismo Chronograph 39 Monza
watches.description: Inspired by the legendary Monza Circuit — the iconic “Temple of Speed” and home of the Italian Grand Prix — the NAGA Granturismo Chronograph Monza Edition captures the raw intensity of high-speed racing. Its fully black dial delivers a bold, stealth-like aesthetic, punctuated by a striking red-tipped chronograph hand — a direct reference to racing instrumentation, warning markers, and the precision timing devices used on track. The result is a clean, aggressive look where every detail serves performance. Housed in a perfectly balanced 39 mm case, this chronograph combines sporty character with refined Italian design. At its core, the Seiko VK64 Meca-Quartz movement offers quartz-level accuracy paired with the mechanical feel of a traditional chronograph, ensuring dependable performance when every fraction of a second matters. High-contrast sub-dials guarantee immediate readability, while the minimalist black layout reinforces the watch’s modern racing identity. 100m Water resistant and screwed crown. Built for speed yet refined for everyday wear, the Monza Edition transitions effortlessly from the circuit to the city, embodying a contemporary motorsport spirit with unmistakable Italian attitude. Born from speed. Designed for those who live life in the fast lane.

watches.name: Naga Granturismo Chronograph 39 Millemiglia
watches.description: Inspired by the legendary Mille Miglia — the most iconic road race in automotive history — the NAGA Granturismo Chronograph Mille Miglia Edition embodies classic Italian elegance and the spirit of vintage grand touring. Its satin gold dial evokes the refined dashboards of historic racing cars, while the contrasting black panda sub-dials deliver both exceptional legibility and timeless motorsport character. This sophisticated color combination captures the essence of mid-century performance machines, where luxury and speed coexisted in perfect harmony. The 39 mm case features a warm gold PVD finish , echoed by the matching gold-tone buckle, creating a cohesive and distinguished presence on the wrist. Inside, the Seiko VK64 Meca-Quartz movement combines quartz precision with the mechanical feel of a traditional chronograph, ensuring reliable performance with a tactile racing experience. 100m Water Resistant and screwed crown Elegant yet unmistakably sporty, the Mille Miglia Edition transitions effortlessly from spirited driving to formal occasions, offering a refined interpretation of classic motorsport. A tribute to golden-age racing and timeless Italian sophistication.

watches.name: Naga Opera 39 Lapis Lazuli
watches.description: L'evoluzione dress del nostro Naga 39 Automatic .Quadranti unici in pietra naturale e finiture eleganti. Pezzi unici, venature irripetibili, come il nostro tempo. Il Lapislazzuli è una delle pietre più iconiche e affascinanti della storia: un blu profondo, intenso e quasi ultraterreno, attraversato da leggere venature minerali e da piccoli riflessi dorati di pirite che ricordano stelle sospese nel cielo notturno. Per la collezione Opera, ogni quadrante viene ricavato da una sottile lastra di pietra naturale, selezionata per equilibrio cromatico, profondità del blu e armonia delle inclusioni. La sua bellezza nasce proprio dall’imperfezione naturale: ogni superficie custodisce una composizione irripetibile di blu, oro e materia minerale. Il Lapislazzuli dona a Opera una presenza elegante e regale. Fin dall’antichità, questa pietra è stata associata a nobiltà, sapienza e mistero; oggi diventa il centro emotivo del quadrante, trasformando ogni orologio in un esemplare unico. Le inclusioni dorate di pirite emergono alla luce con discrezione, creando un effetto prezioso ma mai eccessivo. È un quadrante che non cerca di imporsi: cattura lo sguardo lentamente, con profondità, equilibrio e carattere. Opera Lapis Lazuli è pensato per chi desidera un orologio raffinato, distintivo e senza tempo. Un segnatempo in cui la materia naturale incontra il design italiano, dando vita a una superficie blu intensa, elegante e irripetibile.

specsRaw.Lapis Lazuli is a blue that cannot be pa: it can only be extracted. A fragment of mineral night, crossed by sparks of gold.
